about_pullquote: I started this because I was sick of cowboys overcharging my neighbours for simple fixes.
about_para_1: JC Plumbing and Heating was born from frustration. After watching family and friends get stung by inflated bills and poor workmanship, I decided to do it right: fair prices, honest diagnosis, and work that lasts. In 15 years, we've built a reputation across Wolverhampton for turning up on time, fixing the problem properly, and treating every home like it's our own.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we don't upsell. We've got the skill to spot what actually needs fixing, and the integrity to tell you straight. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned boiler replacement, you get the same no-nonsense service and transparent pricing. That's why repeat jobs and word-of-mouth referrals make up 70% of our work.
reviews_heading: What Wolverhampton Homeowners Say About JC Plumbing

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe at 2am on a Sunday. Rang JC expecting to wait until Monday at the earliest. He was here within 45 minutes, found the fault, replaced the section, and made sure everything was watertight. Charged a fair price for unsociable hours — no rip-off. Brilliant service, will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Boiler died just before Christmas. Thought we were looking at a grand for a new one and days without heating. JC came out same day, assessed it, and talked us through the options without any pressure. Fitted a new one in a morning. He's a straight talker and you know exactly what you're paying for. Top bloke.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: We'd had another plumber quote £600 to power flush our central heating because it was running cold. JC looked at it, bled the radiators, and topped up the system. Job done for a fraction of the price. That's the difference between someone who actually listens and someone on commission.
reviews.author: David K.
